identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The next record the node would send, or null when none is waiting.

message.title: Message
message.description: The message the node would send for it: rows by table, as JSON.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: How many rows each table gave, in message order.

note.title: Note
note.description: Anything that would stop the node sending it, e.g. no rows in any data table.

statements.title: Statements
statements.description: The SQL that was run: the poll, then the reads. Nothing that changes the database.

400.description: Not a Database source node, settings it would refuse to start with, or no connection

502.description: The database refused the connection or a query
